summary: Full V2 regression: 58 pytest backend cases across auth/roles, quiz attempts (points+streak+challenge auto-complete), activities, content, stats, challenges, tournaments (age/scope/one-shot), ideas (fair likes, comments, sorting), leaderboards (students+teachers), chat/mentorship, certificates — 58/58 passing. Playwright E2E covered student dashboard + Mark Done, quiz end-to-end, activity drag-and-drop with @hello-pangea/dnd, Content Hub (areas/tabs/age filter/detail dialog/show solution), Ideas (sort/filter/like toggle/detail comments), Tournaments (join -> one-page quiz -> submit -> live ranking), Leaderboards (students+teachers), teacher dashboard (challenge + open-scope tournament creation), Chat (search, add-as-student, send message), registration (student age -> group, teacher code validation), navbar and protected-route redirects, mobile navbar. No functional blockers found.

minor.issue: Quiz-challenge auto-complete uses db.challenges.find_one({teacher_id,type,quiz_id,date}) — if a teacher creates two quiz challenges for the SAME quiz on the same day, an arbitrary one is completed (reproduced: completion recorded against a duplicate challenge, so the intended challenge stayed 'not completed'). Consider find() over all matching challenges, or reject duplicate quiz challenges per quiz/day.
EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs (e.g. *.test) with 422 while all other validation errors return 400/403 — inconsistent error shape for clients (frontend shows raw detail array risk). Cosmetic only.
Every registered teacher with score 0 is listed in Best/Most Popular (no minimum activity threshold), so brand-new teachers pad the boards. Product decision, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1123 lines and mixes auth, quizzes, tournaments, chat, leaderboards and a 130-line seed routine — split into routers (auth/learning/social/tournaments/seed) and move seeding to a script/module.

POST /api/seed-data only requires any authenticated user; any registered student can wipe and recreate all system quizzes/activities/content and reset demo data. Gate it behind teacher/admin role or an env-provided seed token.
leaderboard/teachers loads all tournaments, entries and every quiz_attempt (to_list(20000)) into memory on each call — will not scale; move the aggregation into MongoDB.
Ideas/quiz-attempt lists use fixed to_list(100..10000) with no pagination on any list endpoint.
touch_streak reads then writes without atomicity and awards streaks per-request; concurrent submissions can double-count (minor).

In leaderboard/teachers the 'best' loop assigns r_copy = r then mutates it (dead alias) — the same dict objects are shared with 'popular' before it is copied; simplify to avoid accidental cross-mutation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (all 9 UI scenarios passed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (58 tests, ~35s, run with `python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -p no:randomly`). It self-purges leftover TEST_ challenges/tournaments at session start (needed because challenge lookups are date+quiz scoped) and registers throwaway users — always run /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py afterwards. Registration requires a real-TLD email (pydantic rejects *.test). teststudent has already submitted to 'Autumn Math Sprint' and completed the 2 seeded task challenges, so re-tests of join/submit or Mark Done need a freshly registered 16-18 student. Playwright notes: on /tournaments you must click compete/view card first, then [data-testid=take-tournament-quiz-btn] on the detail card; tournament options use [data-testid=tournament-q{i}-option-{j}]. @hello-pangea/dnd needs mousedown -> small 12px move -> stepped move -> pause -> mouseup to register a drop. Always wait for data-loaded selectors (challenge-complete-btn-*, student-row-*) instead of asserting right after the header appears.
rca_of_the_issue: Only real defect found: the single failing pytest case (quiz challenge not marked completed) was root-caused to submit_quiz_attempt using find_one on {teacher_id,type,quiz_id,date}; leftover challenges from an earlier run shared the same teacher/quiz/day, so the completion was written against a different challenge id. After purging duplicates the flow passes, but the ambiguity is a latent product bug. Playbook items about httpOnly cookies / brute-force lockout / seed_admin do not apply — this app intentionally uses stateless JWT Bearer tokens with bcrypt ($2b$ hashes verified directly in MongoDB) and has no admin seeding.
